title: Cambridge Hospital Abu Dhabi
hero.text: A flagship rehabilitation & long-term care hospital in the UAE

text: Cambridge Hospital Abu Dhabi is the flagship hospital in the UAE, providing comprehensive post-acute rehabilitation and complex long-term care. Through specialised clinical programmes and a multidisciplinary approach, the hospital delivers structured, patient-centred care designed to support recovery, restore function and improve quality of life.

The hospital is equipped to manage a wide range of complex medical conditions, integrating rehabilitation services with long-term care in a purpose-built clinical environment. With a focus on consistent care, patient safety and measurable outcomes, Cambridge Hospital Abu Dhabi plays a central role in delivering high-quality care across the region.
